text: My daily routine is simple but well organized. I usually wake up at seven o'clock and start my morning with a glass of water and a healthy breakfast. After that, I get ready and begin work at nine. I work until five in the afternoon, with a short break for lunch. In the evening, I like to exercise for about thirty minutes, either running or cycling. Then I have dinner and relax by reading or watching TV. I try to keep the same schedule every day, because consistency helps me stay healthy, focused, and full of energy.
